question: Do smell and taste also appear as reflections in their own loci?
premises: The argument has already been applied to sound and touch.
Smell appears within the organ of smell.
Taste appears clearly in the moisture of the mouth.
inference: Smell and taste likewise appear as reflections in their respective loci.
uncertainties: dantodake is taken idiomatically as the mouth's moisture/saliva.
plain_english: In the same way, smell appears within the organ of smell, and taste appears clearly in the moisture of the mouth.
